gossis_cohort_code.observation: Pinned publisher SQL treats APACHE IVa -1 predictions with score >1 as a readmission proxy. A publisher issue separately recommends replacing eICU -1 with NULL. Neither establishes the exact WiDS export revision or probability availability time.

sources.finding: Public masked MAFs remove variants and may omit true positive somatic mutations; absent rows cannot establish negative gene calls.

Candidate Swiss cohort requires credentialing, CITI training, DUA and contributor study approval. Discharge status and admission-level IDs require compatibility review; hospital target equivalence is not established.

Candidate Austrian cohort includes hospital mortality but requires credentialing, CITI training, DUA and contributor study approval. OffsetOfDeath includes out-of-hospital mortality and must not replace hospital death.
Official access process is gated; not a directly downloadable independent cohort in the present environment.

interpretation: Search findings and further work, not newly completed clinical validation. No pathology PDF, credentialed cohort or patient outcome was downloaded or inspected in this search.
